Theme

Latin word

placet

impersonal use of placeō

agreed, fine by me; placuit, it was agreed, I decided; I like it, it pleases me

    also used · classical · Ter. Ad. 911: Placet, pater lepidissime.; Cic. de Or. 1.155: posteā mihi placuit, … ut summōrum ōrātōrum Graecās ōrātiōnēs explicārem

  • maximē placet: favourite
